title: Data cleanup: reused or restricted, never a dead end
why: Jason, 2026-11-15 (in chat): "They still exist, just hidden: this is a dead end. Either they are reused or moved into restricted"; the table in handoffs/data-cleanup.md approved ("table is right"); drop boxes "Yes their own listing and map pin". Every record a Data cleanup pass takes off now goes back to work: a name and a town is a "Help us find" card (release #51); a name only, or facts resting only on cite-only pages, is a sighting back in the intake (a staged row in crawler_raw_index whose exact match is the hidden listing, so Review's Merge brings that one back: one record); page text for a name with a phone or street address is a sighting "name unknown" (phone and address kept, its page kept to re-read). Sightings carry the retry ladder (decisions/0163 §12: a day, 7, 30, 180 days, for good; an answer resets it), looked up again in the place store from sources we may keep (no fetch, nothing spent): by the daily pass (still off, under the master switch) or the page's Look for answers now. What Review decides is settled: merged in, the listing is back (only with a real name and a phone or street address, else Restricted saying why); approved as another, the hidden one points to it (found); turned down by a person, Restricted. Restricted (0164 R7's tier): page text with nothing else, staged and place-store junk, cite-only facts (links kept), protected and nation-sensitive landmarks; listed on the page by reason with Put back (Undo across passes) and Make it a request (greyed with the reason for landmarks and the guards' holds). New rules: "Mail & package drop-offs" (drop and collection boxes get the new leaf, and ones taken off earlier are put back) and "Taken off by an earlier pass" (release #50's quarantined and row-less sightings, sent where they go now). Everything logged in the ledger with Undo. Migration: one INSERT of the category leaf under the Post Office's group (no UPDATE). FAQ: two new entries, two updated. Built on Sync 2026-11-15 00:21 UTC.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
